usage: Runtime illustrated bodies, hairstyles and wardrobe color masks. Animals reuse the generated design-previews/animals-v1.png.

prompts.brief: Edit the six-character reference into a production modular farming-game body sheet. Preserve the detailed warm rounded 3D storybook style and the six identities in a 3-column, 2-row grid. Remove all hats and scalp hair; keep brows and the elderly man's moustache. All six wear neutral medium-gray rolled-sleeve collared shirts, navy rolled trousers and brown sandals. Relaxed standing pose, arms slightly away from torso, visible hands, both feet separate. Front three-quarter view facing slightly right. Full-body separated sprites, generous transparent padding, no floor, shadows, text or painted checkerboard. Real transparent alpha.

Create five separate hair-only accessories matching the six Vietnamese farmers' soft realistic cartoon style: short layered hair, side-swept bangs, braid, long shoulder-length hair and curls. Medium dark brown with rich sculpted locks and highlights, open face areas, same slight three-quarter right view. Three columns by two rows, sixth cell empty. No faces, skin, heads, hats or mannequin. Wide transparent gutters, no shadows, labels, grid lines or checkerboard. Real transparent alpha.

Edit only clothing of the exact six-person bald body sheet. Preserve identities, expressions, skin, anatomy, pose, camera, sizes and sprite positions. Dress all six in neutral medium-gray denim dungarees with bib, shoulder straps, brass buttons, bib pocket and rolled trouser cuffs over ivory rolled-sleeve shirts. Keep brown sandals. No hair, hats, new items, shadows or labels. Same soft detailed 3D storybook style and transparent alpha.

Edit only the shirts of the exact six-person bald body sheet into neutral medium-gray rural work jackets with open lapel collars, patch pockets, rolled elbow sleeves, small warm brown buttons and a narrow ivory inner shirt. Keep the same heads, skin, ages, identities, pose, sizes, hands, sandals, navy trousers, camera and sprite positions. No hair, hats, props, floor, shadows or labels. Same premium 3D storybook style and transparent alpha.
